name: a defined code with no arm stops being refused, so a new rc is swallowed as #202 was
expect: a defined code with NO arm and NO row is refused (rc 4, row removed)

name: the unguarded-Detail rule stops firing, so #201's regression reads as clean
expect: an UNGUARDED Detail: clause is caught — the exact #201 regression

name: an arm's span runs to the end of file, so a later -n guard silences the finding
edits: stop = marks[i + 1][0] if i + 1 < len(marks) else end_of_case

name: two rc tuples stop being a cannot-run, so the guard picks one and guesses
expect: TWO rc tuples is a cannot-run — the guard must not pick one and guess

name: a dead arm stops being refused, so an arm for a retired code reads as coverage

expect: an OR-pattern arm is a cannot-run, not a silently missing arm

name: structural_lines stops tracking the string state, so a payload continuation reads as an arm
expect: a multi-line payload's continuation is not an arm head

expect: text after esac is not part of the block
